title: CIA jump room to Mars that Obama used

tellings.quote: The story is the CIA story is they go up to the fifth floor and then on the elevator and then it goes across and then they they they jump to Mars and Obama's been there

plain: The story goes that people from the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, ride an elevator up to the fifth floor of a building, cross over, and from there "jump" to Mars, and that Barack Obama, the former US president, has been there. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it on the show, passing on what Andrew Basiago, a man he cites by name, has said. If true, it would mean the government secretly has instant travel to another planet.
